scope: Exact cached JAR/source/recipe evidence for two production trials; no Minecraft client/server execution.
decompiler: CFR 0.152, selected classes only; obfuscated Minecraft method names retained.

classes.claim: Input/output inventory and timer are public. Tick decrements timer; process consumes one input, inserts the recipe output and returns before the next export tick.
One input is consumed by milling; outputs may include random bonuses. Public timer and inventories permit observation.
Kinetic source traversal uses public source/network fields and methods; getSpeed() returns zero when overstressed.
Generated speed depends on active motor state; tick consumes FE and updates activity. A motor merely located nearby does not qualify.
Normal engine exposes tank and generated speed; active tick burns fuel. Observer also requires the diesel fluid registry ID.
Fuel validity, redstone control and fuel-specific speed determine engine activity.
KubeJS block wrapper exposes ID, entity and position. getEntity accesses world state; script checks hasChunkAt before accessing it.
Level wrapper exposes dimension and block wrappers; native mapped Level.hasChunkAt still needs an actual runtime bridge test.
Use server command authority, not player authority. getPlayer accepts a PlayerSelector.
UUID strings convert to a selector for the exact online player; script restricts command targets with a UUID regex.
ItemStack exposes the item registry ID; count remains the normal stack count property.
ServerEvents.TICK is posted at RETURN from tickServer, after world/block-entity ticks. Other mods can still affect runtime ordering.
Copper wire is a registered item. No multimeter registration or recipe in this exact JAR.
Registered meal reward; eating can introduce the nourishment mechanic, holding it is not a quest completion event.

activation_tool.reason: Ordinary registered vanilla survival item; the proposed multimeter has orphan assets only in this version.

new_reward_review.scope: Two new reward items only; exact item matches in existing Item Tasks and inventory_changed criteria, using retained native advancement cache. Tag/custom-trigger closures and runtime team delivery remain unproven.
new_reward_review.electric_wire: 4 brass funnels + 300 XP. Brass tier already reached; supports feed/output logistics. Belt-funnel challenge requires a real interaction, not possession.
new_reward_review.diesel_flour: 8 steak-and-potatoes meals + 300 XP. Consumable expedition supplies; nourishment requires eating, so reward can invite use of that mechanic without automatically completing it on receipt.

runtime_limits: No actual Minecraft or Rhino Java bridge execution. Node tests use explicit API models.
Only ordinary diesel engine with diesel fluid; electrical source is a live motor, not a proof of how its FE was generated.
Observer must stay within 16 blocks, machine and source path must be loaded and stable; max 32 links, 1200 server ticks, 8 observers.
Disable automated feeding/extraction for the one-input control batch. Immediate extraction can prevent credit.
Only the observing UUID receives the advancement; FTB team sharing, reload and saved-world migration untested.
Unfinished observations reset on server unload, disconnect or timeout. Earned advancement uses normal Minecraft persistence, not separately verified here.
